تكتفون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَفُونَ (taktafūna) /tak.ta.fuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
# تُكْتَفَوْنَ (tuktafawna) /tuk.ta.faw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَفَى (iktafā)
